rejected.reason: Unclear rights, even though the page label checks out ('Creative Commons 0', uploader LordHannes). The author's description says it was 'Created from Logic Samples, finished with Echo and Reverb, Sub Bass and some EQ'. Apple's Logic Pro license lets users put its bundled samples inside their own productions, but forbids repackaging them as standalone sound effects or samples. So the uploader probably had no right to release this file as CC0, and that is a direct problem for committing it to a public repo. The two other sub_boom candidates, 428073 and 212768, cover this cue. The file was moved, not hard-deleted, to _rejected_sfx/sub_boom/sub_boom__freesound_268084.mp3, so it is out of sfx_downloads. Delete that file when convenient.
